svg.text: SERVO HATCH A.31 — OF U-FRAME CLEARS JOINER; REMOVABLE SERVO WITH COVER
cover + bezel outer plane, recessed 0.8 mm
2 mm backing ring / 5 mm lip under cover
CF/AIL: two 6x6 rails; OF: one aft 6x6 rail + two chordwise 8x6 side rails
servo mounting blocks are glued to cover; servo comes out with cover
four M2.5 screws pass cover/backing ring into threaded inserts in spruce rails
surrounding film terminates on the fixed bezel, not on the removable cover
CF: C205-C285, centre y=245 mm, x/c=0.54; cover 68x56; bezel/backing 74x62
OF: O230-O350 (global 825-945), centre y=885 mm, x/c=0.54; A.31 U-frame avoids JOINER_O_RAIL
AIL: O785-O880 (global 1380-1475), centre y=1427.5 mm, x/c=0.53326; cover 68x46; bezel/backing 74x52
Bezel and cover are coplanar but 0.8 mm inside the ideal lower contour. No plywood projects outside the wing surface.
Servo body holes remain undrilled until the actual servo is measured. Aileron bay requires a slim wing servo; see SERVO_BAY_SCHEDULE.csv.
Build order: glue rails to ribs -> glue backing ring to rails -> glue bezel to backing -> cover/servo assembly screws on last.
